tldr: Oil prices surpassed $100 a barrel for the first time since July, driven by escalating conflicts in the Middle East, intensifying global inflation fears.
An Anthropic safety researcher stated there is over a 10% chance AI could lead to human extinction by the end of the decade, following a colleague's resignation over AI safety concerns.
New York City released 170,000 documents indicating officials were aware of dangerous air quality around the World Trade Center after 9/11 but did not warn residents.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower as oil prices rose above $100 a barrel for the first time since July, fueled by escalating Middle East conflict and Houthi attacks, which renewed global inflation fears.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased amidst rising oil prices and renewed inflation concerns stemming from the escalating Middle East conflict. The Treasury Department also announced plans to buy back up to $6 billion in longer-term debt, a move three times the normal level.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased as stock indices declined and global concerns mounted due to escalating conflicts in the Middle East and renewed inflation fears.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, a weekly Freddie Mac survey released on 2026-09-03, rose by 0.05% compared to the previous week. This change tracks the general upward movement of the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days, influenced by broader inflation concerns, though specific drivers for this week's increase are not detailed in the provided articles.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_week.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

tech.summary: An Anthropic safety researcher has stated there is more than a 10% chance that artificial intelligence could lead to the extinction of all humans by the end of the decade, following a colleague's resignation over similar fears.
Nintendo has announced a new 2D Metroid game, titled 'Metroid Ravenous,' which will be released for the Switch 2 console on January 28th, 2027.
DeepSeek plans to release its V4.1 Flash AI model around September 10, 2026, claiming it will surpass the V4 Pro model in performance, cost, speed, and task completion.

world.summary: Oil prices have risen above $100 a barrel for the first time since July, driven by escalating conflict between the US and Iran in the Gulf and Houthi attacks on Saudi cities, intensifying global inflation fears.

Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz canceled a phone call with Donald Trump after a social media post from Trump celebrated the far-right AfD party's election win in Saxony-Anhalt, with Merz accusing the AfD of pursuing "ethnic cleansing."
Tens of thousands of people lined the streets of Norway for the funeral procession of King Harald V, marking the end of 13 days of national mourning.

Hurricane Lowell caused significant damage to Hawaii's western coastline, leaving 30,000 residents without power due to torrential rains and winds, with Kauai grappling with flooding and dangerous debris.

us.summary: New York City has released 170,000 documents that reportedly show officials were aware that the air quality around the World Trade Center after 9/11 was dangerous for breathing but did not issue warnings to local residents.

A new federal program implemented at 13 airports allows visitors with TSA PreCheck to pass through security checkpoints without a boarding pass to meet or drop off air travelers, reviving a practice largely discontinued after 9/11.
Flight data indicates that an Amazon cargo plane attempted to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before crashing into a van, killing five people inside.

science.summary: Genetically modified pig kidneys have successfully kept two kidney failure patients alive long enough to receive human kidney transplants, marking a significant advancement in xenotransplantation.
Experts advise that consuming very hot drinks may cause damage to the food pipe and increase the risk of cancer by harming the cell lining on the way to the stomach.
